# Golden Guide

This fixture validates that a structured source is mapped into sections before any promotion candidate is considered. It intentionally contains enough text to pass the extraction gate.

## 1. Architecture

The architecture separates source preservation, document mapping, section notes, reviewable promotion candidates, and formal knowledge pages. Every durable conclusion keeps a backlink to the source note and a precise source reference.

## 2. Workflow

First preserve the original file. Then evaluate extraction coverage. Next create the document map and section index. Finally create bounded section notes, and require explicit review before promotion.

## 3. Verification

Verification checks source hashes, extraction quality, section count, references, excerpt limits, and destination routing. A long source must never collapse into one vague summary.
